source_text: Vidit Aaron et filii Moysen; glorificata facies; timuerunt accedere. Gloria legis terret carnales; invitat spiritales.
pass_a_gloss: Saw Aaron and sons Moses; glorified face; they-feared to-approach. Glory of-law terrifies carnal-ones; invites spiritual-ones.
pass_b_english: [[Aaron and the sons saw Moses; his face was glorified, and they feared to approach >> Bible:Exodus 34:30]]. The law’s glory terrifies the fleshly and invites the spiritual.
